QUOTE: "If no usable root survives, the declaration is rejected and the build falls back to the whole repo, with the rejection reason written into the log." and "The reason string says "no `index_scope` is declared", names the file it looked in, and says the Doxyfile supplies aliases and predefines but not INPUT."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the whole-repo fallback carries a reason string explaining why that scope was used, including when nothing is declared, so no scope is guessed silently.
